nodes.label: LLM Prompt Templates
nodes.rationale: Jinja2-templated prompts for the reconciliation pipeline: language detection, translation, abbreviation expansion, and entity reconciliation

nodes.label: Reconciliation Prompt
nodes.rationale: Core LLM prompt for entity reconciliation: matches input values against controlled lookup lists, returns up to 5 scored candidates with reasons in strict JSON

nodes.label: Translation Prompt
nodes.rationale: Line-by-line translation prompt preserving proper nouns and technical terms, used in the reconciliation pipeline before matching

nodes.label: Abbreviation Expansion Prompt
nodes.rationale: Expands abbreviations line-by-line using context, outputs id,expanded-abbreviation format for improved matching

nodes.label: Language Detection Prompt
nodes.rationale: Detects ISO 639-1 language code of input text, first step in the multilingual reconciliation pipeline
